theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds: Separating Fact from Fiction
body: Myth: Only rich people invest. Truth: Start small, invest regularly. Myth: Too risky. Truth: Diversification reduces risk through professional management.
caption: Common misconceptions often keep people from exploring investment opportunities. Understanding facts helps you make informed decisions aligned with your goals. Knowledge is your best tool for confident investing. #MutualFundMyths #InvestmentFacts #FinancialLiteracy #InvestSmartly #DebunkingMyths
